title: Sources for resolution and expressive limits
sources_and_specific_support: Madhusudan–Viswanathan, [*Logic in Computer Science*](https://courses.grainger.illinois.edu/CS474/fa2021/DraftNotes.pdf), 2021-10-11, §2.2, 27–34, is a collected resolution source whose complete proof still needs a stage-1 audit. Schlicht, [*An Introduction to Model Theory*](https://philippschlicht.github.io/teaching/files/modeltheory2017.pdf), course 2017, PDF dated 2021-07-13, 7, supplies a connectedness example; expand its finite-path witness. Its adjacent upward-extension proof has a recorded diagram defect.
